summary: Protect the intended audience, authorized scope, privacy boundary, and established structure of an artifact.

outcomes: Distinguish implementation inputs from information the intended reader actually needs.
Preserve exact evidence and recovery details only when an established audience task requires them.

scenarios.title: Turn requirements into audience-fit output
scenarios.prompt: Use the audience-scope-discipline skill to turn these requirements into reader-facing content without exposing every available field.
scenarios.outcome: Only details admitted by the reader's current task become visible, while required exact evidence remains usable.

scenarios.title: Guard a narrow implementation
scenarios.prompt: Apply the audience-scope-discipline skill while implementing this request. Do not absorb adjacent cleanup or local setup into the product.
scenarios.outcome: The smallest coherent change, with material risks challenged once and unrelated improvements left separate.
